mines.mine_notes: Flagship in the Golden Triangle, BC. Tudor owns 80% (acquired American Creek Resources Sept 4, 2025). 2026 MRE (eff. Nov 30, 2025; 100% basis; QP Garth Kirkham, P.Geo., Kirkham Geosystems): reported at US$50/t NSR cutoff for a potential underground block-cave scenario; metal prices US$2,750/oz Au, US$34/oz Ag, US$4.25/lb Cu. Indicated 912.3 Mt @ 0.85 g/t Au, 5.07 g/t Ag, 0.15% Cu = 24.9 Moz Au, 148.7 Moz Ag, 3,048.0 Mlb Cu; Inferred 86.1 Mt @ 1.43 g/t Au, 5.22 g/t Ag, 0.17% Cu = 4.0 Moz Au, 18.6 Moz Ag, 327.7 Mlb Cu. PEA on Goldstorm commissioned Feb 2026 (Fuse Advisors). Ongoing land-use dispute with Seabridge Gold (Mitchell-Treaty Twinned Tunnels for KSM project).

notes: No production, no revenue; no reserves (exploration stage). Changed fiscal year-end from March 31 to December 31 in 2025, so FY2025 is a nine-month stub ended Dec 31, 2025. Cash of C$0.92M at Dec 31, 2025. 2025 financings: C$12.5M flow-through (13.16M units @ $0.95) and C$11.5M brokered non-flow-through (14.375M units @ $0.80) closed December 2025. CEO Ken Konkin.
